description: Meals over a period: a day-by-day timeline split into sections, and a tray of cards the agent proposes and you drop. Serves both a plan you decide and a log you record — the mechanism does not distinguish them. A feature rather than an app because a week of meals has no domain and no tile: it hangs off whichever page has a reason to hold it.

meals.description: Meals over a period, drawn from the `.meals.json` that sits beside the page.
